settings/localResolution.title: Local resolution
settings/localResolution.body: Streaming resolution on the local network. Higher looks sharper but needs more bitrate.

settings/localFps.title: Local frame rate
settings/localFps.body: Target frames per second for local-network play.

settings/localBitrate.title: Local bitrate
settings/localBitrate.body: Video bitrate on the local network, adjusted in 500-kbps steps.

settings/remoteFps.title: Remote frame rate
settings/remoteFps.body: Target frames per second for remote play.

settings/remoteBitrate.title: Remote bitrate
settings/remoteBitrate.body: Video bitrate for remote play, adjusted in 500-kbps steps.

settings/vpnResolution.title: VPN resolution
settings/vpnResolution.body: Streaming resolution when connected over the VPN.

settings/vpnFps.title: VPN frame rate
settings/vpnFps.body: Target frames per second over the VPN.

settings/vpnBitrate.title: VPN bitrate
settings/vpnBitrate.body: Video bitrate over the VPN, adjusted in 500-kbps steps.

settings/rcasEnabled.title: RCAS sharpening
settings/rcasEnabled.body: Contrast-adaptive sharpening of the decoded image.
